name: ZooTeens Youth Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer one 5-hour weekend shift a month at the Zoo, from August to May.
who_can_apply: Students entering grades 9 to 12. You do not need volunteer experience.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Teens get a Teen Volunteer membership after two of eight monthly shifts.
duration: August to May, one 5-hour weekend shift per month
deadline_text: 2026-27 applications closed May 31, 2026. Join the interest list for 2027-28 dates.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form. If chosen, you get an interview. Then you get a yes or no. Join the interest list on the page. Questions: zooteens@phoenixzoo.org.
notes: Orientation and training are a must in August and September. Trailblazers Youth Advisory Council is a leadership choice. You can apply to both. You can join only 1.
